prompt: Write src/memo.mjs with `memoLast(fn, max)`. It returns a function that caches the results of `fn` for one argument in an LruBox from vendor/lrubox.mjs. A result of any value is cached, also `undefined`, `null`, and `0`. When `fn` throws, the error goes to the caller and nothing is cached. The returned function has a method `clear()` that empties the cache, and a method `size()` that returns the number of keys in the cache. A `max` that is not a whole number of 1 or more makes `memoLast` throw a `RangeError`. The folder vendor/ has the installed version of the library, and it is not changed. Read docs/lrubox.md first.
